rules.name: Complete Source Bytes and Full Readable Decode
rules.description: Validates that the source file is completely downloaded, matches the expected SHA-256 digest and byte size, has a readable Parquet footer, and all rows decode in 65,536-row PyArrow batches without error.
rules.oracle_predicate: computed_sha256 == accepted_sha256 AND file_bytes == accepted_bytes AND footer_valid == true AND decode_error_count == 0

rules.name: Source Schema Adapter and Column Type Match
rules.description: Validates that the physical schema matches the named adapter for the source period (24 columns pre-2025, 25 columns 2025-onward). Disallows unknown extra columns, missing required columns, and timezone-bearing timestamps.
rules.oracle_predicate: schema_id == expected_schema_id AND missing_columns_count == 0 AND unknown_columns_count == 0 AND timezone_bearing_timestamps_count == 0

rules.name: Zone Reference LocationID Uniqueness and Non-Null
rules.description: Validates that the taxi zone lookup contains 100% unique, non-null integer LocationIDs, and includes mandatory sentinel IDs 1 (EWR), 264 (Unknown), and 265 (Outside of NYC).
rules.oracle_predicate: total_rows == count_distinct_location_id AND count_null_location_id == 0 AND sentinel_ids_present == true

rules.name: Single Contribution per Window Month and Plan Membership
rules.description: Validates that every configured month in the frozen plan has exactly one selected contribution, and the exact set of (logical_source_id, revision_id) matches the frozen plan.
rules.oracle_predicate: contributed_months_set == plan_window_months_set AND count_duplicate_months == 0 AND contributed_revisions_set == plan_revisions_set

rules.name: Row Count Reconciliation and Physical Locator Contiguity
rules.description: Validates for each contribution that decoded_row_count == inserted_row_count == footer_row_count, (revision_id, source_row_number) is strictly unique, and source_row_number is contiguous from 0 to n-1.
rules.oracle_predicate: decoded_rows == inserted_rows == footer_rows AND min_source_row_number == 0 AND max_source_row_number == inserted_rows - 1 AND count_distinct_row_numbers == inserted_rows

rules.name: Derivation Identity and Stale Contribution Absence
rules.description: Validates that all published models, rule results, and references are tagged with the frozen plan derivation_id, and no stale revisions from prior runs exist in any table.

rules.name: Rule Inventory Completeness and Metric Count Identity
rules.description: Validates that all required pre-seal rules (S01-S06, Q01-Q09) completed without ERROR status or missing rows, and verifies the metric count identity total = missing + negative + eligible across trip_qualified. S07 writes its own PASS outcome.
rules.oracle_predicate: missing_rule_count == 0 AND error_rule_count == 0 AND (total_trips == missing_intervals + negative_intervals + eligible_intervals)

rules.name: Finalized Artifact Digest Attestation
rules.description: Post-seal verification: confirms closed analytics.duckdb and validation.json SHA-256 digests match manifest.json exactly, and read-only inspection verifies release_metadata and model schemas. Persisted in SQLite release_verifications.
rules.oracle_predicate: disk_duckdb_sha256 == manifest_duckdb_sha256 AND disk_validation_sha256 == manifest_validation_sha256 AND read_only_inspection_succeeded == true

rules.name: Column Population and Null Rate Profile
rules.description: Evaluates population count, null count, and null rate for every source column, grouped by source month and hvfhs_license_num. Recorded in column_profile.
rules.oracle_predicate: evaluated_count == total_rows_in_cohort AND null_count >= 0 AND (null_count <= evaluated_count)

rules.name: Recorded Request-to-Pickup Interval Distribution
rules.description: Evaluates counts of missing, negative, zero, and positive intervals, and calculates exact continuous median and p95 over eligible non-negative rows via quantile_cont.
rules.oracle_predicate: total_count == missing_count + negative_count + eligible_count AND (eligible_count > 0 IMPLIES median_seconds IS NOT NULL)

rules.name: Temporal Inconsistencies and Trip Time Discrepancies
rules.description: Evaluates temporal anomalies: dropoff prior to pickup (dropoff_datetime < pickup_datetime), on-scene comparisons, and signed discrepancy between source trip_time and recorded (dropoff - pickup).

rules.name: Event Date Off-Source-Month Classification
rules.description: Identifies trips where recorded pickup_datetime falls outside the file's declared source month. Evaluates count and rate; missing pickup datetime counted separately.

rules.name: Location Dimension Join Classification
rules.description: Classifies PU and DO locations into mutually exclusive classes: NULL, matched ordinary (2..263), matched sentinel (1, 264, 265), or unmatched (>265 or invalid). Retains unmatched rows.

rules.name: Numeric Range, Nonfinite, and Sign Profile
rules.description: Profiles numeric fields (trip_miles, fares, fees) for null, NaN, Inf, negative, zero, and positive counts; computes finite-only min, max, median, p95 with explicit exclusions recorded.

rules.name: Categorical Domains and New Code Discovery
rules.description: Monitors distinct values and cardinalities for hvfhs_license_num, dispatching_base_num, originating_base_num, and flags. Detects new codes compared to the adjacent prior month in the frozen plan. Earliest month is NOT_APPLICABLE.
rules.oracle_predicate: (has_prior_month == false AND status == 'NOT_APPLICABLE') OR (has_prior_month == true AND domain_evaluation_completed == true)

rules.name: Exact Normalized Field Row Equality Groups
rules.description: Identifies groups of rows having exact equality across all normalized source fields within each source revision (excluding row locator). Reports group count and excess rows. Does not delete rows.

rules.name: Adjacent Source Month Drift Profile
rules.description: Computes raw differences in null rates, row counts, and interval quantiles by license against the adjacent source month in the frozen plan. Earliest month is NOT_APPLICABLE with explicit reason. No arbitrary anomaly threshold.
rules.oracle_predicate: (has_prior_month == false AND status == 'NOT_APPLICABLE') OR (has_prior_month == true AND drift_computation_completed == true)
